families.family: Variable autotransformers - characteristics, production series and components (general information, no model table)
families.description: The toroidal variable auto-transformer is an essential component if we wish to control a variable A.C.voltage, from zero to the maximum, with a constant degree of current. The Torivac variable auto-transformers are characterised by their mechanical ruggedness, high resolution allowing very precise voltage adjustments and the high quality of the materials used in their manufacturing. These characteristics, together with the quality control of 100% of all our variators, allow us to offer a degree of reliability recognised by the most demanding customers.

general_specs.Production series: Single, dual and triple-phase variable autotransformers (I, II, III)
general_specs.Mounting / control: All models can be mounted in metal box and supply for manual regulation or motorized.
general_specs.Quality control: quality control of 100% of all our variators
general_specs.Function: control a variable A.C.voltage, from zero to the maximum, with a constant degree of current
general_specs.Components (Fig. 1): the core, the electric wound coil, the insulation and the rest of the components; 21 numbered parts (see table of components)

options_accessories: Metal box for manual or motorized regulation: "All models can be mounted in metal box and supply for manual regulation or motorized."

families.family: Variable autotransformers - technical and magnetic specifications (general information, no model table)
families.description: The variable autotransformer is mainly comprised of a toroidal core manufactured using magnetic sheeting with very low loss and high permeability, wound at an angle of approx. 340º. The contact track is comprised of an evenly wound coil, that is trued up, polished and treated with a silver bath to improve the contact with the graphite brush. This treatment allows the reduction of the contact resistance and the rusting of the copper which leads to a longer useful life of the variable autotransformer.

general_specs.Core: toroidal core, magnetic sheeting with very low loss and high permeability, wound at an angle of approx. 340º
general_specs.Contact track: evenly wound coil, trued up, polished and treated with a silver bath (reduces contact resistance and rusting of the copper)
general_specs.Turns per volt: A high number of turns per volt, which allow us to set extremely precise voltage values.
general_specs.Encapsulation: epoxy resin encapsulation: improved dissipation of heat, avoids concentration at the brush contact point (as in air-wound variable autotransformers) and protects against harsh environmental factors
general_specs.Contacts: inside and outside friction contacts generously designed to dissipate the maximum possible amount of heat with the minimum of wear
general_specs.Mechanical tests: Both the motorisations and the mechanical stops have been subjected to mechanical resistance tests
general_specs.Waveform: do not distort the sine-wave signal
general_specs.Temperature rise (external non-metallic: between 45ºC and 60oC, above the environmental temperature at full load (Fig. 2) [printed '60oC']
general_specs.Current limit: adjustment of the voltage without surpassing the nominal current, except at the beginning and the end of the range which may be surpassed by up to 22% (Fig. 3)
general_specs.Induction capacity of the core: between 15.000 - 16,000 Gauss [printed with dot and comma]
general_specs.Saturation curve (Fig. 4): approximately 15% of the nominal voltage rating of the transformer, assuming an imput voltage of 230V
general_specs.Magnetic flux / noise: magnetic flux concentrated within the core in an uniform manner; no intermediate metal parts, vibrations are eliminated; noise caused by magnetostriction practically disappears
general_specs.Operating frequency: designed to operate at 50/60 Hz.; able to operate at frequencies close to 400Hz, taking into account that the hysteresis losses increase considerably

families.family: Variable autotransformers - fields of application and types of control (general information, no model table)
families.description: The variable autotransformers are used to adjust the voltage from 0 volts up to the maximum voltage for which they have been designed.

general_specs.Adjustment range: from 0 volts up to the maximum voltage for which they have been designed
general_specs.Fields of application: Laboratory control equipment; Lighting equipment; Dielectric rigidity equipment; Temperature controls; Galvanic control process; Power-assisted equipment for remote control; Motor speed control; Control of voltage stabilisers; Control of other fixed transformers
general_specs.Manual control: By means of a control button on the shaft of the variator which allows to act on the brush and achieve the desired voltage. We have a wide range of available buttons and dials calibrated in % or in volts, applicable to the different power ratings.
general_specs.Power-assisted control: Is mainly used to remotely control equipment or for stabiliser equipments. The high-powered voltage variators are also usually power-assisted, due to the greater comfort they offer in use. In this type of control the variator shaft is activated by a motor by using a manual switch, which allows increasing or reducing the output voltage. The power assisted control that Torivac installs in the variable Autotransformers stop without inertia; therefore they are ideal for remote control.
general_specs.Stabilised version (by order): By order, we can make them stabilized and controlled by means of an electronic card, with a precision of about 2%. This electronic card allows to regulate the variable autotransformer by means of a potentiometer or by a continuous signal of 0-10Vcc.

options_accessories: Control buttons and dials calibrated in % or in volts (wide range, applicable to the different power ratings)
Electronic card for stabilised versions (by order): potentiometer or continuous signal control, precision of about 2%

other_facts.fact: Cover of the section 'VARIABLE AUTOTRANSFORMERS' with the TORIVAC logotype and a photograph of a toroidal variable autotransformer with a finned contact plate and terminals; no technical data (text read from the image).
Printed page numbers of the section are the PDF page number minus one (PDF page 2 carries the printed number 1); the cover pages carry no number.
The EN text uses 'variable auto-transformer', 'variable autotransformer', 'variator(s)' and 'variac' interchangeably for the product the ES catalogue calls 'variador de tensión'.
Quality: 'the quality control of 100% of all our variators'; mechanical ruggedness and high resolution allowing very precise voltage adjustments.
Fig. 1 (sectioned variable autotransformer) differentiates the core, the electric wound coil, the insulation and the rest of the components; the 21 numbered parts are listed in the components table.
Core made of magnetic sheeting with very low loss and high permeability, wound at an angle of approx. 340º; contact track silver-plated (silver bath) to improve contact with the graphite brush.

Temperature rise of the external non-metallic parts: between 45ºC and 60oC above the environmental temperature at full load (Fig. 2); oil bath or fan cooling are the usual means to reduce it in high-power variators.

Fig. 2 (chart, approximate visual reading): temperature rise in ΔºC (axis 20 to 80) against time in hours (axis 0 to 4); the curve starts near 20 and levels off close to 70 after about the first hour.

Fig. 3 (chart, approximate visual reading): I.max. as % of In (axis 95 to 130) against % of travel (axis 0 to 100); about 100 in the central part of the travel and above 120 at both ends, in line with the text 'may be surpassed by up to 22%'.
Fig. 4 (chart, approximate visual reading): voltage V (axis 0 to 350) against current mA (axis 0 to 400); steep rise at low current, then a flat plateau close to 300 V.

The variable autotransformers manufactured by Torivac are designed to operate at 50/60 Hz.; they may operate at frequencies close to 400Hz, taking into account that the hysteresis losses increase considerably. The text ends there.
Induction capacity of the toroidal core between 15.000 - 16,000 Gauss after heat treatment (printed with dot and comma in the same range).

Photographs (no captions): control panel in a metal cabinet with measuring instruments; two single units of different sizes (the larger one with a finned contact plate); a tall three-unit stack with a control knob on the shaft; and a three-unit stack on a frame with a motor on top.

Power-assisted control: the variator shaft is activated by a motor with a manual switch to raise or lower the output voltage; Torivac power-assisted controls stop without inertia and are ideal for remote control; high-power variators are usually power-assisted.

Section 'SIZE & WEIGHT'. Table notes: '* Limited dimensions' (rows 350* and 500*) and 'In it refers to the nominal current of the variable autotransformers'. Dimensions A to G are drawn in the outline drawings; the PDF prints no unit for them.
Drawing captions (image) for the single-phase units: '5000 VA' and '6000 VA - 11000 VA' (different outline for 5000 VA and for 6000 VA - 11000 VA).

Power-assisted 5000 VA - 11000 VA table continues the single-phase power-assisted tables of the previous page; the double (manual) tables follow with drawing captions '5000 VA x2' and '6000 VA x2 - 11000 VA x2'.
In the double-unit tables the currents are printed per autotransformer as 'xN' (e.g. In 230 of 160x2 is 0.7x2).
Double power-assisted tables with drawing captions '5000 VA x2' and '6000 VA x2 - 11000 VA x2'; the three-phase manual table 480 VA - 12000 VA follows with the currents per phase 'x3'.
Drawing captions (image) '15000 VA' and '18000 VA - 30000 VA' appear for both the manual and the power-assisted three-phase tables, whose ranges reach 33000 VA.
Table notes mix languages: 'In hace referencia a la intensidad nominal del variador/In it refers to the nominal current of the variable autotransformers.' (the third table says 'nominal intensity').

Page 'Desktop Variable Autotransformer 160-1250VA': three photographs (without display, with one digital display, with two digital displays) and outline drawings with dimensions 153,00 / 150,00 / 353,00 (transcribed from the image, no unit).
Photograph of a grey metal tank with a black knob and a terminal block on the top; 3D drawing with A as the vertical dimension and B, C as horizontal dimensions.

Photographs: control cabinet with analogue meters, digital displays, a switch and a rotary knob; and a cabinet on wheels with digital displays. 3D drawings with B as the vertical dimension and A, C as horizontal dimensions.

Safety: the voltage variators are in accordance with CE standards, if they are installed inside a box or enclosure that isolates them from the outside, protecting the user from possible contact with active, electrical and mechanical parts of the variator.

If the voltage variators are not installed inside a protection box or enclosure, contact between the user and the active parts, such as the contact track, connection terminals or the brush, must be avoided.

Three-phase voltage inverters incorporate as standard a bridge between terminals 1-1-1 of each coil (neutral of the star connection) to avoid possible unbalances; single-phase input 1-4 (without elevation) or 1-3 (with elevation), output 1-2.

Motorised regulation: three connection terminals (orange, grey, violet) of the motorised supplement; 230 VAC between Violet - Grey raises the output voltage and between Orange - Grey lowers it; under no circumstances a voltage must be applied between the orange - violet terminals.

Maintenance: place the unit to prevent dust accumulation on the contact track; periodically check the contact carbons and replace them when necessary; periodically check the contact track so that, if necessary, a complete overhaul can be carried out at Torivac's facilities.

Protection: output protected with a fuse with a value 10% higher than the rated current between terminal 2 and the load; input protected with a delayed-action fuse or circuit breaker between the mains and terminal 1, because of the high voltage peak that occurs when coils start up.
Warranty: 12 months from the date of purchase; damage caused by improper handling, or by voltages or currents higher than those specified on the product label, is not covered.
Service: technical department telephone +34 93 312 01 61 (the ES catalogue prints it without the +34 prefix).
Section cover 'PACKED ELECTRIC COILS' with a photograph of a blue encapsulated coil with brown and blue leads (text read from the image); no technical data.

uncertain.item: Contraste con el catalogo ES (Torivac_2024.pdf, mismas paginas)
uncertain.why: Las 171 filas de las tablas de las paginas PDF 5-11 coinciden token a token (cifras, unidades, M-x, asteriscos) con las filas extraidas del catalogo ES en la misma pagina; tambien coinciden los numeros de las paginas 2, 4 y 12 y la pagina 13 (solo difiere el prefijo +34 del telefono). Unica diferencia numerica de formato en p3: ES '15.000 a 16.000 Gauss' vs EN '15.000 - 16,000 Gauss'. Las discrepancias son de redaccion/terminologia (ver los demas puntos). No hay diferencias de cifras entre idiomas.

uncertain.item: Unidad de las cotas A-H y significado de las letras
uncertain.why: Las tablas no imprimen unidad (probablemente mm) ni definen cada letra en texto; solo 'Kg' y 'In (A)' llevan unidad. No se anade unidad ni se interpreta la letra; la columna F es una designacion de rosca (M-4 ... M-12) conservada tal cual.

uncertain.item: Titulo impreso 'Single-Phase Variable Autotransformer (ManualControl)'
uncertain.why: Falta el espacio en 'ManualControl' en el PDF; se conserva literal en 'family'. Propuesta editorial: 'Manual Control' (no aplicar sin aprobacion).

uncertain.item: Referencias de producto
uncertain.why: Las paginas 5-11 no contienen codigos de referencia: cada modelo se identifica solo por su potencia en VA (y la familia). La 'reference' del JSON es '<VA> VA' como en el catalogo ES.

uncertain.item: Nota '* Limited dimensions' en tablas sin nota
uncertain.why: La nota se imprime en las tablas monofasicas y dobles, pero no en las tablas trifasicas, que tambien tienen filas 1000* y 1500* (p7 y p8). Se asume el mismo significado pero no esta escrito; esas filas llevan confianza 'media'.

uncertain.item: Corriente nominal 6000 VA = 26.01 y 11000 VA = 47.85 (tambien x2 y x3: 18000 VA = 26.01x3 y 33000 VA = 47.85x3)
uncertain.why: VA/230 daria aprox. 26.09 y 47.83; el resto de filas de la serie esta truncado a dos decimales de VA/230 (p.ej. 5000 -> 21.73, 10000 -> 43.47). Los valores impresos se repiten en todas las tablas; se conservan con confianza 'media' y se proponen para verificacion antes de mostrarlos como dato fiable.

uncertain.item: Monofasico motorizado 5000-11000 VA, fila 8000 VA, columna H = 235
uncertain.why: El valor impreso 235 rompe la serie (255, 470, 490, 235, 565, 615, 635) y el doble motorizado de 8000x2 imprime 535. Dato dudoso: se deja en null en specs (raw_row conserva el impreso) y se propone revisarlo con el fabricante. Coincide con el catalogo ES.

uncertain.item: Doble manual 160x2-4000x2, fila 2000x2, columna B = 25
uncertain.why: Valor impreso 25 frente a 245 (1500x2) y 312 (2500x2); el doble motorizado de 2000x2 da 335. Posible errata de imprenta; se deja en null en specs (raw_row conserva el impreso) y se propone revisarlo. Coincide con el catalogo ES.

uncertain.item: In 230 (A) de las filas 220x2 = '0.9 x2' (p6, p7) y 660 trifasico = '0.9x3' (p7, p8, p11)
uncertain.why: Las tablas de una sola unidad imprimen 0.95 para 220 VA; las dobles y las trifasicas imprimen 0.9 (el patron truncado dara 0.95 y 0.95x3). Se conserva lo impreso (confianza 'media'); en specs se normaliza el espacio tipografico '0.9 x2' -> '0.9x2' y '8.69x 3' -> '8.69x3' (raw_row conserva el original).

uncertain.item: Fila trifasica 1000 VA: In 400 = 1.52x3
uncertain.why: La corriente impresa para 1000 VA trifasico (1.52x3) es la de la unidad monofasica de 350 VA (1.52); 3 x 350 VA = 1050 VA, y la etiqueta impresa es 1000 VA (VA/(3 x 230) daria aprox. 1.45). Se conserva el valor impreso sin interpretar; revisar antes de publicar la corriente de esta fila.

uncertain.item: Tabla trifasica manual 15000-33000 VA (p8) sin titulo
uncertain.why: La tabla de la pagina 8 no lleva titulo; se asigna a 'Three phase variable autotransformer (Manual Control)' por continuidad con la p7 (mismas columnas A-H con C y D). Asignacion inferida; igual que en el catalogo ES.

uncertain.item: Rotulos de dibujo '18000 VA - 30000 VA' frente a tablas hasta 33000 VA
uncertain.why: Los dibujos rotulan 15000 VA y 18000 VA - 30000 VA; las tablas llegan a 33000 VA. No se sabe a que dibujo corresponde 33000 VA.

uncertain.item: Notas de tabla bilingues y 'nominal intensity'
uncertain.why: Las notas llevan texto en castellano dentro del PDF en ingles ('In hace referencia a la intensidad nominal del variador/...'); la tercera nota dice 'nominal intensity' en lugar de 'nominal current'. Sin implicacion tecnica; proponer unificar en la web.

uncertain.item: Cotas 153,00 / 150,00 / 353,00 (solo en imagen)
uncertain.why: Pagina sin capa de texto util; cotas transcritas del dibujo, sin unidad y sin rotulo que indique alto/fondo/ancho; la asignacion a vistas (153,00 alto del frontal, 150,00 lateral, 353,00 vista superior) es lo que se ve en el dibujo. No publicar sin confirmar unidad.

uncertain.item: Potencia, tension y referencias del sobremesa 160-1250VA
uncertain.why: El PDF solo da el rango del titulo (160-1250VA); no hay tabla ni tensiones ni referencias. No se publica ningun modelo concreto; las pantallas digitales de las fotos son versiones sin descripcion en texto.

uncertain.item: Cabecera '1500 VA - 11000 VA' de la tabla de bano de aceite
uncertain.why: La cabecera no coincide con las filas: monofasico 5000-11000 VA y trifasico 15000-33000 VA (no hay filas de 1500 a 4000 VA). Se conserva la cabecera tal cual; coincide con el catalogo ES.

uncertain.item: Grupo trifasico rotulado 230V/250V
uncertain.why: Las filas de 15000-33000 VA (corriente xN) estan bajo el rotulo vertical 'Trifasico / Triple phase 230V/250V' y la cabecera 'Entrada/Input 230V Salida/Output 230/250V', mientras las tablas trifasicas de las paginas 7, 8 y 11 son 400V / 400-430V. Se conserva literal; verificar la tension de linea antes de publicar.

uncertain.item: Fila 24000 VA trifasico, C = 460
uncertain.why: El monofasico equivalente (8000 VA) tiene C = 480 y el resto de filas trifasicas repiten B y C de las monofasicas equivalentes. Posible errata; se conserva 460 (la imagen coincide) con confianza 'media'.

uncertain.item: Titulo de la tabla 1500-11000 VA: 'in Metallic Cabinet' (EN) frente a 'sobremesa' (ES)
uncertain.why: El catalogo ES titula la misma tabla 'Variador tension sobremesa' y reserva 'sobremesa' para la pagina 9 (160-1250VA); el catalogo EN la titula 'Single-phase Variable Autotransformer in Metallic Cabinet' y a la pagina 9 'Desktop'. Posible error de titulo en el catalogo ES (o en EN): proponer revision editorial; no se asigna uno u otro en la web sin confirmar.

uncertain.item: Rotulos 'In 230 (A)' / 'In 250 (A)' en la tabla trifasica en caja (Input 400V / Output 400/430V)
uncertain.why: Las mismas corrientes (0.7x3/0.64x3 ... 47.85x3/44x3) se rotulan 'In 400 (A)' / 'In 430 (A)' en las tablas trifasicas de las paginas 7 y 8. Inconsistencia de rotulado del PDF; se conservan los rotulos impresos y las 19 filas llevan confianza 'media'.

uncertain.item: Tabla monofasica en caja: sin 'x' y sin indicacion de fase
uncertain.why: Las corrientes sin 'x3' sugieren monofasico, pero la tabla solo dice 'Entrada/Input 230V'; el titulo EN si dice 'Single-phase'.

uncertain.item: Uso de 'inverter(s)' para el variador
uncertain.why: El texto de las paginas 12 y 13 llama 'inverters' ('Single-phase inverters without elevation', 'speed variator', 'voltage inverters') a lo que el catalogo ES llama 'variadores'; en ingles tecnico 'inverter' suele ser un convertidor CC-CA. Mantener 'variable autotransformer' / 'variator' en la web; proponer correccion al fabricante.

uncertain.item: Esquemas de conexion (solo imagen)
uncertain.why: Los numeros de borne (1, 2, 3, 4) y las letras N, R, R1, S, S1, T, T1 se leen del esquema; el significado de 'elevation' no se explica en el texto del PDF y no se interpreta.

uncertain.item: Despiece nº 19 'Contact guide' y nº 18 'Carbon brush glover fastener'
uncertain.why: El catalogo ES rotula el nº 19 'Pista de contacto' y el texto EN de la p3 llama 'contact track' a la pista de contacto, pero la lista EN dice 'Contact guide'. El nº 18 conserva 'glover' (ES: 'Glover de sujecion del carbon'), termino no verificado. Se conservan literales; proponer correccion/traduccion revisada solo tras aprobacion.

uncertain.item: Ligera discrepancia de redaccion EN/ES en 'no intermediate metal parts'
uncertain.why: El EN dice 'as there are no intermediate metal parts, vibrations are eliminated' donde el ES dice 'debido a la ausencia de entrehierrs' (sic, entrehierros = entrehierro/air gap). El sentido tecnico no es identico; no se interpreta.

uncertain.item: Erratas aparentes del PDF EN
uncertain.why: 'imput voltage', '60oC' (letra o en lugar de º), '15.000 - 16,000 Gauss' (punto y coma en el mismo rango), 'A.C.voltage', 'variable auto-transformer'/'autotransformer' alternados, 'do not distort', 'supply for manual regulation'. Se conservan tal cual; proponer correccion editorial solo tras aprobacion.

uncertain.item: Graficos Fig. 2, 3 y 4 (valores leidos a ojo)
uncertain.why: Fig. 2 se estabiliza cerca de 70 frente al texto 'entre 45ºC y 60oC' (probablemente puntos de medida distintos); la curva de saturacion 'en el 15%' es ambigua. Las etiquetas de ejes 'Horas', '% Recorrido', 'I.max. En % de la In' estan en castellano en el PDF EN. Valores del grafico aproximados: no publicar sin confirmar.

uncertain.item: Texto cortado al final de la pagina
uncertain.why: La frase '...hysteresis losses increase considerably' termina sin punto ni continuacion; no se completa.

uncertain.item: Aplicaciones EN frente a ES
uncertain.why: El EN abrevia varias aplicaciones respecto al ES ('Temperature controls' sin 'con cargas resistivas'; 'a motor' en lugar de 'motor-reductor'; 'Laboratory control equipment' frente a 'Alimentacion variable en laboratorios'). Son diferencias de redaccion, no de cifras; la web debe elegir una redaccion por idioma sin mezclar.

uncertain.item: Version estabilizada 'precision of about 2%' y '0-10Vcc'
uncertain.why: Solo se dan en texto 'by order'; no hay tabla de modelos estabilizados ni referencias. 'Vcc' es notacion castellana de V DC dentro del texto EN.

uncertain.item: Telefono del departamento tecnico
uncertain.why: El EN imprime '+34 93 312 01 61' y el ES '93 312 01 61'; coinciden salvo el prefijo internacional.

uncertain.item: Garantia y proteccion
uncertain.why: Garantia 12 meses desde la fecha de compra y fusible de salida 10% superior a la corriente nominal coinciden con el catalogo ES; la web no debe ampliar ni reinterpretar estos textos (p.ej. clase del fusible o del magnetotermico no se indica).

uncertain.item: Orden de secciones distinto entre catalogos
uncertain.why: La pagina 14 del PDF EN es la portada 'PACKED ELECTRIC COILS' (y la p15 abre esa seccion), mientras la pagina 14 del PDF ES es la portada 'TRANSFORMADORES TOROIDALES'. Aunque ambos PDF tienen el mismo numero de paginas, el orden de las secciones tras los variadores no coincide; no se pueden contrastar paginas EN/ES por numero a partir de la p14.

uncertain.item: Emparejamiento de fotos y dibujos 3D con cada tabla
uncertain.why: La pagina 11 no tiene pies de foto: la asociacion del armario mural (fila superior izquierda) y del armario con ruedas con las tablas monofasica y trifasica, y de cada dibujo 3D con su tabla, se deduce de la maquetacion. Ambos dibujos acotan B en vertical y A, C en horizontal. No publicar el emparejamiento sin confirmarlo.
